About our schoolहमारे विद्यालय के बारे में

Kamla Devi Higher Secondary School in Mahuawa Chilua, Kushinagar, was established in 2002 to bring quality education within reach of children in the surrounding community.

Over the years we have focused on learning, discipline, moral values and the all-round development of every student. The school has been recognised by the Government of Uttar Pradesh since 2014.

Our vision

To be a trusted centre of learning where every child discovers their potential, builds confidence and prepares for a successful future.

Our mission

  • Quality education in a supportive environment.
  • Discipline, honesty and respect.
  • Curiosity, creativity and independent thinking.
  • Sports, cultural activities and teamwork.
  • Responsible citizens for tomorrow.

Message from the Principalप्रधानाचार्य का संदेश

At Kamla Devi Higher Secondary School, we believe education is not limited to textbooks and examinations. It is about building character, confidence, discipline and the ability to face life’s challenges.

Our aim is to give every student an environment where they feel encouraged to learn, explore their talents and work towards their dreams. Every child has unique potential, and with dedicated teachers, supportive parents and responsible management, we guide our students towards a bright future.

We welcome parents and students to become part of our educational journey.

श्री धर्मदेव यादव
Shri Dharmdev Yadav
Principal

Admissions open for 2027–28प्रवेश सत्र 2027–28 के लिए खुले हैं

We welcome students who want a strong educational foundation in a supportive learning environment. Admission is subject to seat availability and school rules. Fee details are shared at the school office.

Ask about admission on WhatsApp

How to apply

  1. Visit the school office.
  2. Collect the admission form.
  3. Submit the required documents.
  4. Complete the admission formalities.
  5. Receive confirmation from the school.

Eligibility

  • Nursery: as per the applicable age criteria.
  • Higher classes: based on previous academic record.
  • Transfer Certificate needed for students coming from another school.

Documents required

  • Birth certificate, where applicable
  • Previous class report card
  • Transfer Certificate (transfer cases)
  • Passport-size photographs
  • Aadhaar details, where required
  • Parent or guardian ID and contact details
